title: OTT Rule v2 (DSL)
description: Declarative fetch rule for the restricted L1.5 DSL engine. Validates the 'rule' field of an ott-rule source in a Repo v1 manifest; each source item is validated independently, so mixed repos (instance + rule + bridge, multiple rule sources) work unchanged. Superset of L1: rules with only legacy fields (request + extract + transform, no steps) remain valid; rules with 'steps' use the sequential DSL pipeline. Single rules MUST NOT mix 'transform' with 'steps'.

url.description: Public http(s) target only; file:/loopback/private/reserved ranges are rejected by the interpreter.

headers.description: HTTP headers; Content-Type etc. must be declared explicitly (no auto JSON header).

body.description: Literal request body, or null when constructed via 'steps'. str passes through, dict/list are JSON-serialized, int/bool are stringified; float and other types are rejected. When 'steps' is present and body is null, the first step is not prepended with the body.

extract.description: JSON path, named regex group, or CSS selector per field (e.g. {"title": "$.msg.a_name", "content": "$.msg.0"}).

transform.description: L1 fixed pipeline; MUST NOT coexist with 'steps'.

steps.description: Sequential DSL pipeline; each step output becomes the next step's first arg unless body is null. First step receives request.body. Max 8 steps (MAX_STEPS); engine enforces MAX_CALLS=1000 and MAX_DEPTH=32 at runtime.

fn.description: Whitelisted pure primitive; unknown fns are rejected.

args.description: Literal values, nested expression trees, or {"ref": "body"} to reference the request.body literal. No float type; bytes are expressed via utf8_encode/hex_decode etc.

network.description: Domain whitelist (subdomains match); enforced at declaration time - a URL outside the whitelist rejects the whole rule. When absent, the baseline validate_url policy applies.

min_api_level.description: Client API level below this marks the rule incompatible and skips it.
